sentences.text: Physics -LRB- from -LSB- φυσική , phusikḗ -LRB- epistḗmē -RRB- , knowledge of nature -RSB- , from φύσις phúsis `` nature '' -RRB- is the natural science that involves the study of matter and its motion and behavior through space and time , along with related concepts such as energy and force .	natural science	natural science	matter	matter	motion	Motion (physics)	space and time	Spacetime	energy	energy	force	force
One of the most fundamental scientific disciplines , the main goal of physics is to understand how the universe behaves .	universe	universe
Physics is one of the oldest academic disciplines , perhaps the oldest through its inclusion of astronomy .	astronomy	astronomy

Over the last two millennia , physics was a part of natural philosophy along with chemistry , biology , and certain branches of mathematics , but during the scientific revolution in the 17th century , the natural sciences emerged as unique research programs in their own right .	natural philosophy	natural philosophy	chemistry	chemistry	biology	biology	mathematics	mathematics	scientific revolution	scientific revolution	research	research	philosophy	philosophy

Physics intersects with many interdisciplinary areas of research , such as biophysics and quantum chemistry , and the boundaries of physics are not rigidly defined .	chemistry	chemistry	research	research	interdisciplinary	interdisciplinary	biophysics	biophysics	quantum chemistry	quantum chemistry	rigidly defined	demarcation problem

New ideas in physics often explain the fundamental mechanisms of other sciences while opening new avenues of research in areas such as mathematics and philosophy .	mathematics	mathematics	research	research	philosophy	philosophy
Physics also makes significant contributions through advances in new technologies that arise from theoretical breakthroughs .	technologies	technology

For example , advances in the understanding of electromagnetism or nuclear physics led directly to the development of new products that have dramatically transformed modern-day society , such as television , computers , domestic appliances , and nuclear weapons ; advances in thermodynamics led to the development of industrialization , and advances in mechanics inspired the development of calculus .	electromagnetism	electromagnetism	nuclear physics	nuclear physics	society	society	television	television	thermodynamics	thermodynamics	industrialization	industrialization	mechanics	mechanics	calculus	calculus
The United Nations named 2005 the World Year of Physics .	United Nations	United Nations	World Year of Physics	World Year of Physics
